areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly tied to urban mobility; clear specific objectives, indicators and targets; all components and resources address the area; impact and efficiency shown quantitatively at the maximum standard.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Link to sustainable use of the environment (emissions, pollution) is acknowledged, but no components or products directly serve the area.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Domestic industrial content of rolling stock is relevant, but no components, resources, targets or indicators tied to the area were presented.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Jobs arise only from construction and operation as positive externalities; no resources or priority targeting of vulnerable residents for employment.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Energy efficiency gains from electric rail are not reflected in objectives, indicators, targets, components or resources.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Program is relevant to intra-metropolitan inequality, but no specific objectives, indicators, targets or resources address the area.
